training_scope: 198 co-located lidar and field plots in Quebec, Ontario, and the Northwest Territories; 25 m x 25 m lidar plots, first returns above 2 m.
source: Wulder et al. (2012), Canadian Journal of Remote Sensing 38(5): 600-618, https://doi.org/10.5589/m12-049. Equation: exp(-2.79766 + 1.411911 ln(Lhmean) + 0.31286 ln(Lhcv) + 0.28910 ln(CC2m)) x 1.0401 x (25^2/20^2). Published plot RMSE 2.74 m3; output_scale=16 converts plot totals to per hectare.

applicability.notes: Fitted to boreal lidar plots. Applying this card outside the boreal domain is a transfer test, not an operational inventory claim.

caveats: Published model coefficients are used as published; FEMIC did not refit them.
The local feature table is a CHM proxy for first-return lidar metrics; that is not an exact replication of the published predictors.
The TFL 6 pilot is CWH, outside the boreal training domain; this is a transfer test only.
The published plot RMSE is 2.74 m3; the card RMSE is scaled to m3/ha.
No P48/P49 or independent field-plot validation was available for this run.
